description: Generate all app layer PHP files: Enums, Models, Repositories (interfaces + Eloquent implementations), Services, Exceptions, Events, Listeners, Policies, Providers, Middlewares
steps: Create app/Enums/OrderStatus.php - cases: Precommande, Nouvelle, EnAttenteMesures, EnProduction, Prete, Livree, Annulee. Methods: label(), color(), allowedTransitions(), canTransitionTo(), isTerminal()
Create app/Enums/OrderType.php - cases: Physique='physique', ADistance='a_distance', Precommande='precommande'. Method: label()
Create app/Enums/ReminderType.php - cases: PreLivraison, Retard, Precommande, Manuel. Method: label()
Create app/Enums/UserRole.php - cases: Admin='admin', Client='client'. Method: label()
Create app/Models/User.php with HasFactory, nom/email/password/role fillable, role cast to UserRole enum, isAdmin()/isClient() helpers, client() hasOne relation
Create app/Models/Client.php with relations: user, commandes, mesures, mesuresGenerales, consentements, rappels. Scopes: active, search. Helper: hasConsentement()
Create app/Models/CategorieModele.php with relations: modeles, mesureTypes (pivot categorie_mesure_types), mesureTypesObligatoires. Scope: active

Create app/Models/Modele.php with relations: categorie, commandes, realisations. Casts: prix_base decimal, coefficient_complexite decimal, images_supplementaires array, is_active boolean. Scope: active. Helper: getPrixBaseCalcule()

Create app/Models/Commande.php with all relations (client, modele, accessoires BelongsToMany with pivot, mesures, rappels, realisation). Casts: type->OrderType, statut->OrderStatus, dates. Scopes: enCours, terminées, annulees, precommandes, pourClient, enRetard, aLivrerCetteSemaine, byStatut. Helpers: isEnRetard(), joursRetard()
Create app/Models/CommandeAccessoire.php (pivot model if needed)
Create app/Models/Accessoire.php with fillable, is_active cast, commandes relation, scope active
Create app/Models/MesureType.php with fillable, scopes: base, specific, ordered. Relation: categories
Create app/Models/MesureClient.php with fillable, casts, relations: client, commande, mesureType
Create app/Models/RealisationPortfolio.php with fillable, casts (images array), relations: commande, modele
Create app/Models/Consentement.php with fillable, casts (accepte boolean), relation: client
Create app/Models/Rappel.php with fillable, casts (date_echeance date, is_done boolean), relations: commande, client. Scopes: pending, overdue, forCommande

Create app/Repositories/Contracts/OrderRepositoryInterface.php with methods: find, create, update, findByLienSuivi, getByStatut, getEnRetard, getALivrerCetteSemaine, getRecent, getLastOfYear, getForClient
Create app/Repositories/Contracts/ClientRepositoryInterface.php
Create app/Repositories/Contracts/CatalogueRepositoryInterface.php
Create app/Repositories/Contracts/AccessoryRepositoryInterface.php
Create app/Repositories/Contracts/MeasurementRepositoryInterface.php
Create app/Repositories/Contracts/PortfolioRepositoryInterface.php
Create app/Repositories/Contracts/ReminderRepositoryInterface.php
Create app/Repositories/Eloquent/OrderRepository.php implementing OrderRepositoryInterface
Create app/Repositories/Eloquent/ClientRepository.php implementing ClientRepositoryInterface
Create app/Repositories/Eloquent/CatalogueRepository.php implementing CatalogueRepositoryInterface
Create app/Repositories/Eloquent/AccessoryRepository.php implementing AccessoryRepositoryInterface
Create app/Repositories/Eloquent/MeasurementRepository.php implementing MeasurementRepositoryInterface
Create app/Repositories/Eloquent/PortfolioRepository.php implementing PortfolioRepositoryInterface
Create app/Repositories/Eloquent/ReminderRepository.php implementing ReminderRepositoryInterface

Create app/Services/Dashboard/DashboardService.php with getDonneesDashboard() returning compteurs, commandes_en_retard, commandes_a_livrer_semaine, commandes_recentes, rappels_urgents, precommandes_en_attente
Create app/Services/Order/CommandeService.php with creerCommande, mettreAJour, changerStatut, validerPrecommande, rejeterPrecommande, annulerCommande, fixerPrixFinal, trouverParLienSuivi
Create app/Services/Pricing/TarificationService.php with recalculer, calculerDetails, estimer, validerCoefficient
Create app/Services/Measurement/MesureService.php with verifierCompletude, getMesuresManquantes, enregistrerMesure, enregistrerMesuresEnLot
Create app/Services/Notification/NotificationService.php with creerRappelAutomatique, creerRappelManuel, marquerFait
Create app/Services/Catalogue/CatalogueService.php with getModelesByCategorie, getModeleDetails, creerModele, updateModele
Create app/Services/Client/ClientService.php with creerClient, updateClient, getClientDetails, getClientsActifs
Create app/Services/Accessory/AccessoryService.php with getAll, creer, update, toggleActive
Create app/Services/Portfolio/PortfolioService.php with getRealisations, creerRealisation, supprimerRealisation
Create app/Exceptions/BusinessException.php extending RuntimeException
Create app/Exceptions/InvalidOrderTransitionException.php extending BusinessException
Create app/Exceptions/InsufficientMeasurementsException.php extending BusinessException
Create app/Events/OrderCreated.php, OrderStatusChanged.php, OrderDelivered.php, OrderCancelled.php, PreorderValidated.php
Create app/Listeners/LogOrderStatusChange.php, CreateAutomaticReminder.php, CreateMeasurementReminder.php, ArchiveOrderReminders.php
Create app/Policies/OrderPolicy.php, ClientPolicy.php, MeasurementPolicy.php
Create app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php (standard)
Create app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php with event-listener mappings
Create app/Providers/RepositoryServiceProvider.php binding all 7 interfaces to implementations
Create app/Http/Middleware/EnsureIsAdmin.php, EnsureIsClient.php, EnsureConsentGiven.php
acceptance_criteria: All PHP files pass php -l syntax check
All service method names are consistent: DashboardService has getDonneesDashboard()
All 7 repository interfaces have matching Eloquent implementations
All model relationships reference correct table/foreign key names
OrderStatus enum has proper state machine transitions
verification: Run find /projects/sandbox/Atelier-couture/app -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; and confirm no syntax errors
